page_title: CAG 2-3 FIO | Cagliari v Fiorentina 23/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+13' 2 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Simone Scuffet no chance!
90+12' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+11' Referee Alessandro Prontera awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
90+11' Referee Alessandro Prontera makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Fiorentina. Let’s see what happens!
90+4' Today's match ends for Simone Scuffet who will be replaced by Simone Aresti (Cagliari).
90+4' Here is a change. Ibrahim Sulemana is going off and Claudio Ranieri gives the last tactical orders to Marco Mancosu (Cagliari).
90+4' Alessandro Prontera shows a yellow card to Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) for a tough tackle.
90+3' Substitution. Nahitan Nandez makes his way off the pitch and Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari) comes on as his replacement.
90+2' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) sees a yellow card from Alessandro Prontera after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+1' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Alessandro Prontera has issued a yellow card to M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina).
89' 2 - 2 Cristiano Biraghi floats a lovely ball in from the free kick to Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina), and he strikes the ball inside the left post to increase the score to 2:2.
87' It seemed like Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
85' 2 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Kingstone Mutandwa (Cagliari) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the right post.
85' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) makes a rough challenge and Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle for a foul.
84' The resulting corner from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
78' Here comes a substitution. Kingstone Mutandwa (Cagliari) is brought on as a substitute for Zito Luvumbo.
78' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) replacing Alessandro Deiola.
75' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
75' The linesman signals that Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) for Andrea Belotti.
73' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Giacomo Bonaventura is replaced by Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina).
71' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
66' Substitution. Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) replaces Nikola Milenkovic.
64' Referee Alessandro Prontera points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) goes wild in celebration.
64' The Cagliari players joy may have been justified, because referee Alessandro Prontera is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
64' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
60' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Nicolas Viola (Cagliari). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
56' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Rolando Mandragora and he is replaced by Arthur Melo (Fiorentina).
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jonathan Ikone leaves the pitch and Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) comes on.
53' CHANCE! Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) receives a brilliant pass and finds himself one-on-one with Pietro Terracciano, who reacts superbly to stop him.
52' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) is adjudged offside.

49' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alessandro Prontera no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Fiorentina.
48' The resulting corner from Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
45+4' Yellow card! It's like Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Alessandro Prontera agrees and books him.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' The foul by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Alessandro Prontera.
44' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner with a short pass.

43' Gaetano Castrovilli (Fiorentina) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the right side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Simone Scuffet, who tips the ball around the post. Fiorentina get a corner.
43' The game is interrupted. Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

39' 0 - 1 Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Simone Scuffet is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top left corner. The score is 0:1.
35' Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle and signals a foul after Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) brought his opponent down. A free kick to Fiorentina.
34' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
32' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) makes a strong challenge and Alessandro Prontera blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Fiorentina.
30' Adam Obert (Cagliari) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the left post, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop the effort.
30' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

28' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but Pietro Terracciano is alert and denies him with a nice save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Cagliari are going to take it.

27' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
27' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
26' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. Cagliari will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
25' The resulting corner from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is cleared by the defence.
24' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Fiorentina force their opponents to concede a corner.
23' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) meets a cross inside the box, but Pietro Terracciano wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
20' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
19' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Fiorentina are awarded the free kick.
18' Dodo (Fiorentina) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alessandro Prontera blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Cagliari, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
15' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
11' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Simone Scuffet comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
4' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Fiorentina will kick the game off.
Alessandro Prontera is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
